knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

```{r message= FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(flexdashboard)
library(readxl)
library(DT)
library(bactcountr)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
```

Input {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
inputPanel(
  fileInput("formatted_data", label = "Data Upload")
)
```

Raw Metadata
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}

metadata <- reactive({
   read_xlsx(input$formatted_data$datapath, sheet = "metadata") %>%
    as.data.frame()
})

DT::renderDataTable({
    metadata()
})

```

Cleaned CFU Data
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
**note that for now this only works if the volume plated is 100 uL
```{r}

CFU_data <- reactive({
   read_xlsx(input$formatted_data$datapath, sheet = "CFU_data") %>%
    as.data.frame()%>%
  tidy_CFU() %>%
  pick_one_dilution("CFUs", c("group", "mouse"))  %>%
  calculate_cfu(dilution_factor = metadata()$dilution_factor,
                resuspend_volume_ml = metadata()$resuspend_volume,
                percent = metadata()$percent_organ, "dilution", "CFUs")
})

DT::renderDataTable({
    CFU_data()
})
```


Plots
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
sig <- reactive({
 CFU_data() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(group, log_CFUs) %>%
    mutate(group = as.factor(group)) %>%
  rstatix::tukey_hsd(log_CFUs ~ group) %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "group")
}) 

name_of_plot <- reactive({
  paste(metadata()$exp_name, "D", metadata()$timepoint, metadata()$organ, "CFUs")
})

renderPlot({
  ggline(x = "group", y = "log_CFUs", color = "group", alpha = 0.5, data = CFU_data(),
       font.label = list(size = 30, face = "plain")) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(data = sig(), hide.ns = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(name_of_plot())
})

```
